title: Where homemade is made.
slide_intent: Pair a broad promise with a scene that lets a passerby supply its meaning. Hands reaching across a table make a shared meal visible at a glance.
strategic_value: Instacart can associate its service with the occasion groceries enable through a headline, a photograph and a modest signature.
demonstration: A poster on a tiled wall pairs a dark three-line headline on cream with an overhead photograph of food and hands. The signature sits at the lower left.
practical_value: Use this example to decide how much information an outdoor placement can carry. Leave the headline and shared meal as the two dominant reads.

content_islands.name: Placement
content_islands.spec: Show the wide framed poster against the tiled wall so its format and viewing context remain visible.

content_islands.name: Message and signature
content_islands.spec: Align the three-line headline at the upper left of the cream field and place the small Instacart lockup well below on the same edge.

content_islands.name: Meal photograph
content_islands.spec: Fill the right side with a rounded-corner overhead crop of dishes, hands and a drink, close enough for the viewer to read the food textures.
